text: {"edits": [{"finding_ids": ["pydantic_cli/examples/simple_schema.py:16:config-class"], "search": "        cli=(\"-f\", \"--input-file\"),", "replace": "        json_schema_extra={\"cli\": (\"-f\", \"--input-file\")},", "explanation": "Pydantic V2 deprecates extra keyword arguments on Field (PydanticDeprecatedSince20, 'Extra keys: cli'). Per the V2 migration guide, arbitrary metadata must go in json_schema_extra. The value is unchanged, so pydantic_cli still sees the same 'cli' key in the field's extra metadata."}, {"finding_ids": ["pydantic_cli/examples/simple_schema.py:16:config-class"], "search": "        cli=(\"-m\",),", "replace": "        json_schema_extra={\"cli\": (\"-m\",)},", "explanation": "Same as above: move the non-standard 'cli' Field kwarg into json_schema_extra to remove the deprecated extra-kwargs usage in Pydantic V2."}, {"finding_ids": ["pydantic_cli/examples/simple_schema.py:16:config-class"], "search": "        cli=(\"-s\",),", "replace": "        json_schema_extra={\"cli\": (\"-s\",)},", "explanation": "Same as above: move the 'cli' Field kwarg into json_schema_extra so Field no longer receives extra keyword arguments."}, {"finding_ids": ["pydantic_cli/examples/simple_schema.py:16:config-class"], "search": "        cli=(\"-S\",)", "replace": "        json_schema_extra={\"cli\": (\"-S\",)}", "explanation": "Same as above: move the last 'cli' Field kwarg into json_schema_extra. The trailing comment line is left untouched."}], "notes": "The failing collection error comes from Field(..., cli=...) passing an extra keyword argument, which Pydantic V2 deprecates. The fix is to move each cli=(...) into json_schema_extra={\"cli\": (...)}, which keeps the same metadata key and value. The model_config = ConfigDict(...) migration from the previous attempt is already correct and is kept. The ConfigDict key CLI_SHELL_COMPLETION_ENABLE is a custom key that the failure does not mention, so it is left alone. The '# or extras=' comments are not code and are left as is. I did not verify the edits by running the tests. I also did not check how pydantic_cli/core.py reads the 'cli' metadata. If it reads field.extra, it would need to read field.json_schema_extra, which is outside this file. That change belongs to core.py, which is a separate file in this migration."}
